name: travel_notice
description: Record upcoming travel so the card is not blocked abroad.

client_id.description: Client identifier returned by find_client, or supplied by the orchestrator. Never invent one.

card_id.description: Card identifier returned by list_cards. Never invent one.

destination.description: One to ten countries or US states, exactly as named on BNY's list (e.g. "France", "Texas", "Georgia (country)"). Cities are not accepted; ask which country or state. Ambiguous names are resolved by the system with buttons.

start_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Never infer a date without showing it to the advisor first.

end_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Must be on or after start_date; a notice covers at most 14 days.
